task_description: Hallway coordination environment with 4 agents. Each agent has different state range: agent0: 0-4, agent1: 0-6, agent2: 0-8, agent3: 0-10. All agents must reach state 0 simultaneously. Reward is +1 only if all agents reach state 0 at the same time. Each agent observes its own current state and active status. Actions: 0=stay, 1=move left, 2=move right.
